faqs.question: What is the TriVersa® NanoMate® used for?
faqs.answer: It's a chip-based nanoelectrospray ionization platform combining LC/MS, infusion, fraction collection, and direct surface analysis, used for applications like shotgun lipidomics, protein characterization, and non-covalent interaction studies.

faqs.question: How much sample does the ESI Chip need?
faqs.answer: As little as 3 µL, sustaining up to 15 minutes of stable spray.

faqs.question: What happens if the spray fails during a run?
faqs.answer: An internal counter electrode senses the failure and the system recovers automatically, rather than losing the run.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right emitter size for my sample?
faqs.answer: Match your analyte type and sample characteristics to one of three confirmed ID sizes, 2.5 to 5.5 µm; Inkarp can confirm the specific recommendation for your application.

faqs.question: How do I set up automated sampling from a well plate?
faqs.answer: The system delivers spray directly from 96 or 384 well plate formats, automated as part of the standard workflow.

faqs.question: How do I re-analyze a result identified during an online LC/MS run?
faqs.answer: Excess LC eluate is physically saved as fractions during the run, which can then be re-analyzed by infusion once a result of interest is identified.

faqs.question: Is TriVersa NanoMate suitable for large analytes like proteins?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-throughput infusion is confirmed for both small and large analytes, including protein characterization applications.

faqs.question: What makes this different from a conventional nano-ESI source?
faqs.answer: The 400-nozzle silicon chip design and integrated LC/MS, infusion, fraction collection, and direct surface analysis capabilities combine into one platform, described as the only automated platform offering high-throughput infusion this way.

faqs.question: What is the price of the TriVersa® NanoMate® in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your chip configuration and application requirements. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your workflow is confirmed.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor of the TriVersa® NanoMate® in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Advion Interchim Scientific TriVersa® NanoMate® in India, providing demonstration, installation, training, AMC, spare parts, and technical support.

longForm.heroLead: Precious samples don't forgive a spray that fails halfway through a run. TriVersa NanoMate is built around a chip that doesn't let that happen. The ESI Chip carries 400 nano-electrospray nozzles etched into a silicon wafer, each one reproducibly fabricated to perform identically. From just 3 µL of sample, that design sustains 15 minutes of stable spray, and an internal counter electrode senses spray failure and recovers automatically rather than losing the run. It combines LC/MS, chip-based infusion, fraction collection, and direct surface analysis in one integrated platform, extracting more information from complex samples than LC/MS running alone. Excess LC eluate gets physically saved as fractions during an online run, so anything interesting in the real-time data can be pulled and re-analyzed by infusion afterward.

Sample efficiency is a real, quantified number. 15 minutes of spray from 3 µL, not a vague "low sample consumption" claim.

The confirmed applications are genuinely advanced. Shotgun lipidomics and non-covalent interaction studies sit alongside protein characterization, not routine screening.

sections.eyebrow: ESI Chip Technology and Spray Reliability
sections.title: ESI Chip Technology and Spray Reliability
body: Reliable spray from a vanishingly small sample volume depends on two things: how the chip is built, and what happens when something goes wrong mid-run.

The 400-nozzle array, etched into a silicon wafer, is fabricated with a highly reproducible method specifically so every nozzle performs equally, not just so there are many of them available. That consistency is what makes 15 minutes of stable spray from only 3 µL achievable in practice, not just on paper. And because an internal counter electrode continuously senses the spray, a failure doesn't end the run, the system recovers automatically.
